channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Go 1.27 is released
item.description: Go 1.27 adds generic methods, encoding/json/v2 package, uuid package, faster memory allocation, goroutine leak profiles, and more. (3 sources: goblog, hackernews, lobsters)

item.title: Next.js 16.3: Instant Navigations, Up to 90% Less Dev Memory and Faster Builds
item.description: Vercel has released Next.js 16.3, featuring significant updates since version 16.0. Enhancements include reduced memory usage during development, accelerated build times, and improved type checking. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Microsoft Releases Aspire 13.5 With a Refreshed Dashboard and Workflow Improvements
item.description: Last week, Microsoft released Aspire 13.5, an update that refreshes the dashboard and the aspire.dev homepage and adds several quality-of-life features. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: X.Org Server 26.1 RC1 Prepares For First Feature Release In Five Years - Phoronix
item.description: Following today's release of XWayland 26.1 RC1, X.Org Server 26.1 RC1 was tagged (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Harper Argues Against the Multi-System Stack and Releases 5.2
item.description: The database platform Harper advocates for a single-runtime architecture that keeps application code and data together, with its benchmark against a Vercel-based stack reporting significantly better performance on live, personalized-data… (1 source: infoq)

item.title: The Open-Sourcing of DeepSeek Harness Opens the Door to Modular, Unbundled AI Agent Infrastructure
item.description: DeepSeek has released a developer preview of DeepSeek Harness (dsh), an open-source execution runtime for building autonomous AI agents. The software features a micro-kernel architecture with modular plugins for various functional units. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Launching External Web Access for Web Search on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Earlier this month, we announced Web Search on Amazon Bedrock , a built-in server-side tool that allows you to ground model responses with current web knowledge, while maintaining data within your secured AWS environment with zero data… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Web Search in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore adds domain and published date filtering, expands to Europe and Asia Pacific
item.description: Web Search in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore now supports domain filtering and published-date filtering, giving agents per-request control over which web sources and time windows they search. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon CloudWatch log Centralization now supports log group tag propagation
item.description: Amazon CloudWatch Centralization now copies log group tags from source accounts to the destination log groups created by centralization rules. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon SageMaker notebooks now support trusted identity propagation
item.description: Amazon SageMaker Notebooks now support Trusted Identity Propagation (TIP) with Amazon Athena, Amazon Redshift, and Amazon EMR Serverless, enabling per-user access control for data analytics. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon CloudWatch pipelines adds GeoIP, RDS, and XML processors
item.description: Amazon CloudWatch pipelines now includes three new processors that parse and enrich log data as it's ingested: an Amazon RDS log parser, an XML parser and a GeoIP enrichment processor. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Cost Anomaly Detection supports third-party models on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: AWS Cost Anomaly Detection now monitors spend on third-party foundation models running on Amazon Bedrock, such as Anthropic Claude and other provider-hosted models. (1 source: aws)
